title: Charles Hall and the tall whites at Indian Springs
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Charles Hall and the tall whites at Indian Springs, about 1960s at Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: have you heard of uh Colonel Charles Hall

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings up a man he calls Colonel Charles Hall, whose story is about tall, pale beings known as the tall whites. The story is set in the Indian Springs Valley in Nevada in the 1960s. If true, it would mean non-human beings were living near a US military area at the time.
